planets.name: WASP-33 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-33 with a 1.22-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-33 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-33. Its orbit and size follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CHAKRABARTY__AMP__SENGUPTA_2019): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.21987089, pl_radj 1.593, pl_bmassj 2.093

quotes.title: WASP-33b
quotes.card: WASP-33b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star HD 15082.
quotes.introduction: It was the first transiting planet discovered to orbit a Delta Scuti variable star.
